what: The JavaScript d3 was ported from, vendored so the port can be checked against it offline.
source: https://registry.npmjs.org/d3/-/d3-5.16.0.tgz and the d3-* packages it depends on
d3_min_js_note: The npm d3@5.16.0 dist/d3.min.js is byte for byte the d3.v5.min.js that the web reference loads from https://d3js.org/d3.v5.min.js, which is the same file with the same sha256.
